bull.b: The sharp improvement in quarterly revenue, gross margin, and adjusted EBITDA indicates that acquisitions and operating integration are beginning to improve the business model. If sustained, stronger unit economics can support reinvestment and move GameSquare toward durable operating profitability.

TubeBuddy adds a high-margin recurring software component to GameSquare’s broader media portfolio. Subscriber growth and much stronger conversion among activated users suggest product engagement can support scalable revenue and improve the company’s blended margin profile over time.

A substantial locked-in revenue base and full renewal among agency-of-record clients provide meaningful visibility into future sales. These indicators reduce reliance on entirely new bookings and support management’s FY2026 outlook, although execution remains important for the remaining revenue.

bear.b: Despite strong reported revenue growth, GameSquare remains deeply unprofitable and continues consuming cash. Sustained operating and net losses can limit internally funded investment, increase reliance on external capital, and make the recent operating improvement difficult to convert into durable financial strength.

bear.t: Rising leverage and weaker equity cushion
bear.b: The sharp increase in debt relative to equity has weakened the company’s financial cushion while profitability remains negative. Higher leverage can constrain capital allocation and increase sensitivity to execution setbacks, leaving less flexibility as management works to scale the business.

The proposed FanEngine transaction could materially dilute existing shareholders before considering additional earnout shares and contingent cash payments. Although it may expand digital fan engagement, the structure raises the amount of performance and integration value required to justify the new capital issued.
